import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text
import numpy as np

# Find Chek Lap Kok weather station
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, station_code
FROM weather_station
WHERE name_en ILIKE '%chek lap kok%'
""")
ws_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Weather stations matching Chek Lap Kok:")
print(ws_df)

# Find Tung Chung air quality station
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE name_en ILIKE '%tung chung%'
""")
aq_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("\nAir quality stations matching Tung Chung:")
print(aq_df)

# Query hourly visibility from Chek Lap Kok weather station for October 2025
query_vis = text("""
SELECT datetime, visibility
FROM hourly_station_weather
WHERE station_id = 7
AND datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
ORDER BY datetime
""")
vis_df = pd.read_sql(query_vis, engine)
print(f"Visibility records: {len(vis_df)}")
print(vis_df.head())
print(f"\nVisibility stats: mean={vis_df['visibility'].mean():.2f}, nulls={vis_df['visibility'].isna().sum()}")

# Query hourly PM2.5 from Tung Chung air quality station for October 2025
query_pm = text("""
SELECT datetime, pm2_5
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 6
AND datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
ORDER BY datetime
""")
pm_df = pd.read_sql(query_pm, engine)
print(f"\nPM2.5 records: {len(pm_df)}")
print(pm_df.head())
print(f"\nPM2.5 stats: mean={pm_df['pm2_5'].mean():.2f}, nulls={pm_df['pm2_5'].isna().sum()}")

# Merge on datetime and compute Pearson correlation
merged = vis_df.merge(pm_df, on='datetime', how='inner')
print(f"Merged records: {len(merged)}")

# Drop rows where either value is null
merged_clean = merged.dropna(subset=['visibility', 'pm2_5'])
print(f"Clean records (no nulls): {len(merged_clean)}")

# Compute Pearson correlation
vis_pm25_corr = round(merged_clean['visibility'].corr(merged_clean['pm2_5']), 4)
print(f"\nPearson correlation between hourly visibility and PM2.5: {vis_pm25_corr}")

# Compute daily average visibility and PM2.5
merged_clean['date'] = merged_clean['datetime'].dt.date
daily = merged_clean.groupby('date').agg(
    avg_visibility=('visibility', 'mean'),
    avg_pm25=('pm2_5', 'mean')
).reset_index()

# Find lowest and highest visibility days
low_vis_row = daily.loc[daily['avg_visibility'].idxmin()]
high_vis_row = daily.loc[daily['avg_visibility'].idxmax()]

low_vis_date = str(low_vis_row['date'])
low_vis_value = round(float(low_vis_row['avg_visibility']), 1)
low_vis_pm25 = round(float(low_vis_row['avg_pm25']), 1)

high_vis_date = str(high_vis_row['date'])
high_vis_value = round(float(high_vis_row['avg_visibility']), 1)
high_vis_pm25 = round(float(high_vis_row['avg_pm25']), 1)

print(f"Lowest visibility day: {low_vis_date}, avg visibility: {low_vis_value}, avg PM2.5: {low_vis_pm25}")
print(f"Highest visibility day: {high_vis_date}, avg visibility: {high_vis_value}, avg PM2.5: {high_vis_pm25}")

# Print all daily values for context
print("\nAll daily averages:")
for _, row in daily.sort_values('avg_visibility').iterrows():
    print(f"  {row['date']}: vis={row['avg_visibility']:.1f}, pm2.5={row['avg_pm25']:.1f}")
